correctness.rationale: Under a positive junction sink the real-axis eigenvectors of the non-Hermitian generator are precisely sink-orthogonal adjacency eigenvectors. Their reducing projector fixes the asymptotic survival. Deleting the junction yields two Dirichlet paths; even indices have zero endpoint sum and odd common eigenvalues yield precisely one mixed mode when both reduced cycle quotients are odd. Normalizing that mixed mode gives the 2/(m+n) sin-squared site weight. Root-of-unity sums give the stated residues and 2-adic perfect-capture equivalence. Dense eigenspace/projector checks and finite-time sink checks corroborate; numerical checks are not used as proofs.

originality.rationale: General dark-state projector and sink transport framework was published in 2006–2010, but the exact two-loop Dirichlet endpoint cancellation, gcd-indexed mixed dark modes, every-site survival, and equality-of-2-adic-valuations criterion were not stated by any inspected primary result. Targeted semantic and text searches found no dominating table. An unidentified broader cycle-wedge theorem remains a real publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete infinite-family two-loop trapping classification, not a numerical census or arbitrary parameter slice. Its two-adic full-capture boundary is physically interpretable: at a diametrical site a second ring can either open perfect absorption or preserve a nonzero dark fraction based on its 2-adic length. The exact projection weights and rank answer precise network-detection questions beyond the general existence of symmetry-protected dark states.
